test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark(?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f158fd375ae3ecbee9d47e4f11e1d490af8af82e55d4b8ec9c891dc13eab05f.png]
solution:
The given series of figures is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a572afd944fb237ef3594a93d470cbe6c418e6dd556b33633dd561ed6357904.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Step - I: The odd-number figure has only 1 arrow with a small plus-shaped circle on the left side, and a triangle below it.

Step - II: The even number figure has 2 arrows with a small triangle on the left side, and a small plus-shaped circle below it.

So, the fifth figure will be the same as the 1st image because it is an odd-number image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baefbbd80caa55ce8eab34b5472fa1ca979664129513f1be3f17b7aee6646ad6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
